note: A pair here is a restatement the project keeps on purpose. Every entry names the reason, and the ceiling bounds the list so it cannot grow into a way of passing.
injected_duplicate: The arm runs destructors only where the compiler has emitted unwind cleanup tables, which is the effect of compiling with exceptions enabled.

exempt_files.CHANGELOG.md: A released entry records what the project said at that release and is not rewritten afterwards, so it is held to the claim audit and not to the one-home rule.
